# Constructed_Reality_Model

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A model where the system's internal representation of the environment is actively constructed through hierarchical inference, rather than passively received from sensors. This concept guides the design of neuromorphic in-network processors that build and update internal world models for efficient data interpretation.
